scope: Authored visual kinematics; finite sampled states, not clinical or AAA-quality validation.

independentMeshAudit.method: Actual loaded product GLB, actual five animation clips and runtime pose; triangle BVHs, three-direction majority parity, unchanged 50 micrometre penetration threshold. Buried anatomical proximal/palm unions are excluded; exposed digit surfaces and terminal skin into the palm are checked.

limits: Procedural figures and separate closed skin junctions remain stylized; no clinical motion capture or force/tissue deformation validation.
Supporting contacts use an authored local skin-plane target. Heel pressing is outside the arm reach from the recorded low-back fixture stance and is hidden with explicit reach feedback.
Offline deterministic video output frame rate is separate from actual browser rendering performance.

browserStills.limits: Palmar inspection retains partial cuff occlusion of the wrist. These captures do not establish AAA or clinical fidelity.
